audit.whatIsWrong: Four rows contradict their own reasons. Both layers read Neeko / Skill / Poppy / Poppy / Neeko / Poppy / Poppy, while whys[0] says 'neither can punish', whys[1] says 'Still even', whys[2] says 'it stays a skill matchup', whys[3] says 'farm even', and whys[5] says 'you own the wave and roam tempo while she's still a low-damage tank'. The packet chart (Skill x4 / Neeko / Neeko / Poppy) matches all seven reasons and matches the 51.07% win rate.
audit.why: This is a genuinely flat lane that swings twice: Neeko's Level 6 and first item, then back to Poppy on two tank items. The chart currently gives Poppy first item — the exact row the page describes as Neeko's takeover.
audit.corrected: Skill / Skill / Skill / Skill / Neeko / Neeko / Poppy, as matched full+content pairs with ratings.

audit.why: Four spikes with sound timings: her Level 3 poke window, her Level 6, her first item, and Poppy's dive window. spikes[2] and the first-item chart row now agree.
audit.corrected: Timings kept; the Hammer Shock knockup claim inside spikes[3].text corrected.

audit.whatIsWrong: (a) HAMMER SHOCK IS NOT A KNOCKUP. whys[0] ('she has only Q-knockup'), wants.foe[0] ('then Q-knockup to chain CC') and spikes[3].text ('Q-knockup chains a gank') all give Poppy's Q a knockup it does not have. Riot's text: she swings her hammer, dealing damage and creating a zone that slows and explodes after a delay — 430 range, 8/7/6/5/4s. The knockup in her kit is Keeper's Verdict. (b) STEADFAST PRESENCE DOES NOT BLOCK YOUR ROOT. whys[2] and wants.you[0] tell the player to land E 'from max range so she can't W-block the gap'. Steadfast Presence stops enemy DASHES near her; Tangle-Barbs is a skillshot projectile and is not a dash, so W has no interaction with it at all. wants.foe[1] makes the same error the other way, calling Neeko's W clone a dash. (c) MISSING: Keeper's Verdict is a channel — a landed Tangle-Barbs cancels it and burns 140s at rank 1. The page names the ult three times and never offers the counterplay. (d) MISSING: Iron Ambassador's buckler is a pick-up shield that absorbs the burst window; nothing on the page mentions it.
audit.why: A player who thinks W eats their root will hold Tangle-Barbs waiting for a window that never closes, and a player who thinks Q knocks up will misread which of her spells actually starts a kill. Meanwhile the two things that genuinely decide the fight — her buckler shield and her cancellable ult — are absent.
audit.corrected: Hammer Shock is a slow zone. Heroic Charge (475 range, 14s at rank 1) is the wall-stun and the real threat, which is why you hug open ground. Steadfast Presence (20s at rank 1) stops dashes only. Keeper's Verdict is a 140s channel your root cancels. Force the Iron Ambassador buckler out before you commit.
sources: enemyKit P/Q/W/E/R text, ranges, cooldowns and flags

edits.before: Late game tilts to Poppy. Once she's two tank items deep she eats your single rotation — your E-Q-Pop Blossom combo no longer kills, and if you whiff E you have no follow-up and a squishy body she walls. Her ultimate (Keeper's Verdict) also boots you out of any teamfight you try to bomb. Win on your 6-and-first-item lead: take the tower, roam, and snowball the map before she out-sustains you. If it goes long, stop trying to solo her — group, set your ult from fog, and only commit when her W and her tank stats can't save the carry you actually want dead.
